summary: Phase 1 Glass Messenger — full backend + frontend testing. Backend: 25/25 pytest checks pass (health, signup incl. validation + duplicate-409, login incl. wrong-creds 401, /auth/me with/without token, logout, PATCH /users/me persistence, avatar upload + static serving + non-image rejection + auth-required, openapi reachable, seed users alice/bob/charlie all login with password123). Frontend (Playwright e2e): 14/14 flow steps pass — /login renders, signup new user redirects to / and stores auth_token, sidebar shows display_name/@username, /settings edits & persists display_name + bio (verified across reload), avatar upload via hidden input updates img src to /api/uploads/avatars/<file>, EN↔FA language toggle flips text and applies document.body.dir (rtl/ltr), logout clears auth_token from localStorage and returns to /login, seed alice login succeeds, wrong password shows error toast. JWT bearer auth working end-to-end; no integration regressions.

minor.issue: Username validator lowercases input before regex check, so a request with username='BadCaps' is silently accepted and stored as 'badcaps'. Behaviour is consistent with login (which also lowercases) but worth documenting; consider rejecting non-lowercase input explicitly if strict UX feedback is desired.

Content-Type detection is based purely on the client-supplied header (ext_map). A malicious client could send Content-Type: image/png with a non-image payload; server stores it without MIME sniffing. Acceptable for Phase 1 but flag for future hardening.
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); FastAPI recommends lifespan handlers. Works fine today but will emit deprecation warnings in newer FastAPI.

issues: Visual polish is good — glass cards, gradient blobs, contrast all readable; no contrast issues spotted at 1440x900.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 327-line file. Acceptable for Phase 1 (auth+profile only), but plan to split auth/users/uploads into separate routers before Phase 2 (chat) to keep files <700 lines.

CORS uses allow_credentials=True with default allow_origins='*'. Browsers will reject credentialed requests against '*'; current frontend uses Bearer tokens (not cookies) so it works, but set explicit CORS_ORIGINS in production.

MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES=100MB is enforced both via Content-Length header and streamed chunk count — good. However the Content-Length check uses int() without try/except; a malformed header could raise 500. Wrap in try/except for robustness.

Avatar deletion on replace is best-effort but doesn't validate the prev path is inside AVATAR_DIR (Path traversal). Since avatar_url is server-set this is currently safe; still consider Path(prev).resolve() under AVATAR_DIR.resolve() check.
Auth flow uses HS256 JWT with 7-day expiry; refresh tokens / rotation not implemented (out of scope for Phase 1, but log for Phase 2).
test_credentials: alice/password123, bob/password123, charlie/password123 (seed users, documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md).
seed_data_creation: Tests create fresh users with unique usernames (uuid suffix) per session; no cleanup required as data is harmless. Seed users are auto-created on first backend boot.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_glass_messenger.py (25 tests, all pass). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://neon-glass-app.preview.emergentagent.com. Frontend stores JWT in localStorage key 'auth_token'. To inject auth in Playwright: POST /api/auth/login then localStorage.setItem('auth_token', token) before navigating to /. Avatar uploads available at /api/uploads/avatars/<filename>. Phase 2 will add chat — current code structure is clean foundation.
